statement: The pinned Linux hid-logitech-dj driver groups receiver HID interfaces under one shared receiver state and creates child HID devices for paired endpoints, including keyboard and pointer types. The code accepts device indices 1 through 7, but this index range is not an independently measured physical concurrent-device capacity or a four-gamepad guarantee.

applicability.scope: Logitech DJ host-side receiver aggregation and heterogeneous HID children; pattern evidence only, not gamepad protocol
